name: Klara Steiner
bio:
Klara's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through racing herself, but through a deep fascination with the engineering intricacies of race cars. After earning a degree in Mechanical Engineering from Graz University of Technology, she initially worked in automotive R&D before transitioning to Formula One as a junior data analyst. Over the years, she developed a keen eye for detail and an exceptional ability to translate complex technical data into actionable insights for drivers and engineers.

At Triple Eight Race Engineering, Klara thrives in her role as Test Driver Coordinator. She's responsible for planning and executing comprehensive testing programs, ensuring that every test session yields valuable data to improve car performance. She's known for her rigorous methodology, her ability to maintain composure under pressure, and her unwavering dedication to achieving optimal results. Klara's approach is very analytical, focusing on extracting the maximum amount of information from each test run.

What sets Klara apart is her talent for bridging the gap between the technical world of engineering and the practical needs of the drivers. She can effectively communicate complex concepts in a way that's easily understood, fostering collaboration and ensuring that everyone is working towards the same goal. Klara's goal is to make sure the team always has the best data to use.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, straight, often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Klara is a woman of average height with a focused, intelligent gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with detailed notes and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Drinks copious amounts of herbal tea throughout the day.
